'''Christian David Thomas''' {{Post-nominals|country=GBR|FRES|FRS}} (born 9 September 1959) is a past president of the [[Royal Entomological Society]].<ref name="Professor">{{cite web |title=Professor C D Thomas FRES FRS |url=https://www.royensoc.co.uk/people/professor-c-d-thomas-fres-frs |website=Royal Entomological Society |accessdate=19 February 2019}}</ref> He has also served as Director of the Leverhulme Centre for Anthropocene Biodiversity at the [[University of York]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Lindsey Gillson|url=https://www.york.ac.uk/anthropocene-biodiversity/people/lindsey-gillson/|publisher=University of York}}</ref>

He completed his first degree (BA) in [[Applied Biology]] at the [[University of Cambridge]], followed by an MSc in ecology at the University of Bangor and a [[PhD]] at the [[University of Texas at Austin]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Professor Chris D Thomas|url=http://www.york.ac.uk/biology/research/ecology-evolution/chris-d-thomas/|publisher=University of York}}</ref> A professor in the Department of Biology at the University of York, he has also served as director of the Leverhulme Centre for Anthropocene Biodiversity until 2024, a new £10 million transdisciplinary research centre funded for 10 years from 2019.<ref>{{cite web|title=People|url=https://www.york.ac.uk/anthropocene-biodiversity/people/|publisher=University of York}}</ref> In July 2012, he was elected as a [[Fellow of the Royal Society]].<ref>{{cite web|title=The Royal Society|url=http://royalsociety.org/people/chris-thomas/|publisher=The Royal Society}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
*''Inheritors of the Earth: How Nature Is Thriving in an Age of Extinction''. 2017. {{ISBN|978-0241240755}}
